name: search_api_reference
description:
Search API references for exact method signatures, property types, and event definitions.

Available engines: unity, unreal_ue4, unreal_ue5

ONLY use this when you already know a specific class or method name and need its exact signature, parameters, or return type.
Do NOT use this for conceptual questions, tutorials, or 'how do I...' queries — use search_docs instead.

Returns raw API surface: method signatures, property types, event handler signatures, and class inheritance info.

Example: search_api_reference('OVRInput.Get button', engine='unity')
Example: search_api_reference('AMRUKAnchor RayCast', engine='unreal_ue5')

engine.description: Which API index to search. Options: unity, unreal_ue4, unreal_ue5

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)
